mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payroll growth exceeding 200,000 jobs signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings expectations, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 200k (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to generate positive Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates strong household demand, which increases corporate revenue visibility and supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal produces Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.0% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, it indicates a high-inflation environment with tight monetary policy, which increases the cost of capital and suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS > 3.0 and CPIAUCSL > 2.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average, combined with a rising GDP growth rate (GDPC1), indicates robust aggregate demand, which strengthens corporate earnings outlook and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS > 12-month MA and GDPC1 > 0.5% q/q (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% combined with a rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 150,000, signals a tightening labor market that pressures wage growth and inflation, prompting the Fed to raise rates, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS > 150k (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average, coupled with a decline in housing starts (HOUST), indicates a broad-based supply-side contraction, which raises recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO < 6-month MA and HOUST < 1250k (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
